data.gender_notes: Kamru is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kamru is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, which is associated with the Hindu goddess Kamadevi or Rati, the goddess of love and fertility. The name is believed to bring happiness, joy, and a sweet disposition. The name Kamru carries the meaning “Goddess of Love and Fertility” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Kamru usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love and fertility and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kamru is a divine name that represents the feminine energy of love, desire, and fertility. It is believed to invoke the blessings of the goddess Kamadevi or Rati, who bestows the gifts of love, happiness, and abundance.
data.etymology: Kamru belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Love and Fertility.”
